title: Roald Amundsen reaches the South Pole
summary: A Norwegian party of five led by Roald Amundsen reached the South Pole using dog sledges, five weeks ahead of Robert Falcon Scott's British expedition.
reason: Amundsen changed his plans from the North Pole after hearing it had been claimed, and raced Scott to the south.
significance: It was the first human arrival at the South Pole, a peak of the heroic age of polar exploration.
